item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 11/Apr/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The trough of low pressure now over central China will develop into a cold front tomorrow. It will bring showers and severe squally thunderstorms to Guangdong. The cold front is expected to move across the coastal areas of Guangdong later tomorrow. Under the influence of the associated dry northeast monsoon, the weather will improve gradually over Guangdong early next week. It will be slightly cooler in the morning, with rather large temperature difference between day and night. A southerly airstream is expected to affect the coastal areas gradually in the middle and latter parts of next week. The weather will become humid over the region.

Date/Month: 12/04 (Saturday)
Wind: South force 4 to 5, north force 5 later, occasionally up to force 8 offshore and on high ground.
Weather: Cloudy with occasional showers. Coastal mist at first. Showers will be heavier in some areas with a few squally thunderstorms during the day. Showers will ease off gradually at night, and temperatures will drop significantly.
Temp range: 18 - 25 C
R.H. range: 60 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
